title: knowledge enrichment result
description: What one enrichment pass returns about one staged object. The consumer reads it rather than the filesystem: whether the four fields were written is a claim only the producer can make, and reading the file back would tell a written field from an unwritten one without telling either from a field the pass declined to write.

contract_version.description: A consumer rejects an artifact it was not built to read rather than inferring version from shape.

result_id.description: This result's own identifier, distinct from the object's. A run enriches many objects and a reader tracing one report back to one pass needs the pass named; `object_id` names what was read, never what produced the reading.

producer.description: The named producer. A const rather than a free string, so a document claiming another producer is not an instance of this contract.

consumer.description: The named consumer. It reads `state` to tell an enriched object from a blocked one, and reports `findings` to whoever reviews the staging tree before promotion — which is the only place a finding is acted on, because the pass that could act on it has already finished.

state.description: `enriched` means the four fields were written and the authoring gaps they close were removed. `blocked` means they could not be, and `blocking_reason` names what was missing — never a field the pass filled to get past it.

blocking_reason.description: What was absent, in terms a caller can act on. Present exactly when `state` is `blocked`: a reason beside a success says two things at once.

object_id.description: The object this pass read, by the identifier it carries. The prefix moved with the profile: `ko.` spelled a vocabulary that collapsed eight kinds into six, and `dm.` spells the kinds themselves.

object_path.description: Where it sits in the staging tree. Computable from the identifier, and stated anyway so a report is actionable without the arithmetic.

gaps_closed.description: The `kind: authoring` gaps this pass closed, by field name. A `kind: domain` gap is never closed here: only whoever knows the domain closes one, and a pass that removed one would be asserting the domain answered.

findings.description: Defects in what the expansion decided, reported and never edited. Absent where there are none: an empty array and an absent key would say the same thing twice, and `searched` is what distinguishes having looked from having found.

severity.description: `defect` — the object states something the material does not support. `question` — the pass could not tell, and says so rather than choosing.

searched.description: Whether this pass looked for defects at all. Separate from `findings` because an absent array cannot distinguish a pass that searched and found nothing from one that did not search — and absence of findings is a claim, which a reader is entitled to see made rather than inferred.

allOf.description: An enriched result says what it closed and whether it looked; a blocked one says what stopped it and closed nothing.

then.description: A finding reported by a pass that says it did not search is a contradiction the contract refuses rather than a report a reader has to reconcile.
